name: Pasta with Tomato Sauce
recipe:
1. Cook pasta noodles according to package instructions.
2. Chop tomatoes, onion, and garlic.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook onion and garlic.
4.Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Mix sauce with cooked pasta and serve.
description: Classic pasta with homemade tomato sauce.

name: Chicken Salad
recipe:
1. Grill chicken breast and slice it.
2. Chop lettuce, tomato, and onion.
3. Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
4. Drizzle olive oil on top and serve.

name: Cheesy Garlic Pasta
recipe:
1. Cook pasta according to package instructions.
2. Heat olive oil and cook minced garlic.
3. Toss pasta with garlic and olive oil.
4. Sprinkle grated cheese on top and serve hot.
description: Quick pasta with rich cheesy garlic flavor.

name: Tomato and Cheese Sandwich
recipe:
1. Slice tomato and cheese.
2. Lightly toast bread slices.
3. Spread olive oil and sauté garlic and onion.
4. Assemble sandwich with tomato, cheese, and sautéed vegetables.
5. Serve warm.
